sources.entry: sqlectron - A simple and lightweight SQL client desktop/terminal with cross database and platform support.

summary.one_liner: sqlectron-gui is a simple, lightweight SQL client desktop app with support for multiple databases and platforms.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and describes the project as a simple, lightweight SQL client with cross-database and cross-platform support. It lists the app's documented sections: supported databases, downloads (installers, binaries and source), saved server configuration and custom settings, in-app help docs, and a terminal-based interface. It also links to contribution details. The README does not name specific databases, platforms, or setup steps, so those details are unknown from this text alone.
use_cases: query and browse SQL databases from a desktop app
run SQL from a terminal interface
lightweight alternative to heavier database admin tools
notable: Offers both a desktop GUI and a terminal-based interface
Cross-database and cross-platform support, per the README
Saved server configurations and custom settings
caveats: README is brief; supported databases, platforms and build steps are not listed in it
Installation and run instructions are not given in the README
